rk_sdk.changes: Added new helpers and improvements to support the latest rk_factions update, along with various stability fixes.
rk_sdk.update: Replace the existing rk_sdk resource with this version before updating rk_factions.

rk_factions.changes: Moved stashes directly into rk_factions, added faction stash management, optional CK permissions, stash gundrops, new sounds, and various organization and performance improvements.
rk_factions.update: Replace the existing resource with the latest version and ensure rk_sdk v1.0.6 or newer is installed before starting rk_factions.

rk_stashes.changes: Moved into rk_factions and is no longer a separate resource.
rk_stashes.update: Remove the old rk_stashes resource. Stashes are now included directly with rk_factions.
